build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a ball dropping onto a bottom wall with static obstacles
generate_star_line: generate a line of star positions with randomized steps and angles for obstacle placement
convert_to_radians: convert an angle value from degrees to radians for trigonometric calculations
add_scene_objects: add dynamic balls, static balls, and static bars to the PHYRE scene using the creator API
update_task_relationships: update the task to define a TOUCHING spatial relationship between the ball and bottom wall
